name: Cloudflare Sigrun Service-Binding Harness
summary: A catalogued Cloudflare service-binding harness for Sigrun.

behavior.target: Resolve the exact service contract and actor binding; this catalog entry alone does not prove them.
behavior.assay: Compare a source-bound card capsule against matched factual instructions on held-out tasks. Freeze carrier, tools, budget and evaluator; record constraint violations, useful outcomes and operator corrections. See /cards/behavior-assay.json.

runtime.note: Source engineering maturity is a historical author assertion, not fresh runtime evidence.

art.prompt: Original HFO editorial science-fantasy. Obsidian, restrained crimson light, ivory highlights, etched technical geometry, tactile mineral and archival-paper textures. Vertical 4:5, one clear central silhouette, quiet crop margins. No text, numerals, logos, badges, evidence stamps, franchise characters or recognizable franchise art. Conceptual illustration only. Subject: Cloudflare Sigrun Service-Binding Harness. Show a detachable instrument with an exposed adapter coupling. Express the intended role without depicting deployment, victory or authority.
art.alt: Planned conceptual illustration for Cloudflare Sigrun Service-Binding Harness; no artwork generated.

behavior_contract.intent: Candidate behavior: turn the named harness into a source-resolved compatibility proposal for Sigrun's required service interaction.
behavior_contract.when_to_use: When a WorkItem needs an existing service capability and the catalog alone cannot establish its interface.
inputs: Requested operation, actor identity and effect ceiling
Pinned harness/source configuration, interface references and budget
procedure: Locate the existing service contract in supplied source; retain missing interfaces explicitly.
Map the caller's required input and output to that contract without guessing methods.
Separate actor identity, carrier session, service binding and permission.
Prepare source-derived request/response fixtures and a bounded verification handoff to the runtime owner.
outputs: Candidate fixtures, missing bindings and verification scope
failure_modes: A harness name treated as a callable interface
Service binding assumed to prove durable storage
Invented endpoints or implied execution authority

example.situation: A consumer needs information exposed by an existing service.
example.action: Recover the relevant read contract and prepare a fixture within the WorkItem's scope.
example.evidence: Expected: pinned interface references and fixture expectations; source inspection supplies no hosted-call receipt.

neurosymbolic.neural: Interpret the consumer need and locate a compatible operation.
neurosymbolic.symbolic: Bind the recovered interface, identity, revision and effect ceiling.

mutable: Mapping explanations and source-derived fixture coverage
evolution.fitness: Evaluate accurate contract mapping and useful handoffs under fixed source fixtures; naming a harness earns no runtime credit.
